newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CDC says results to be published Jan 11.
newsitem.headline: CDC says results to be published Jan 11.

text.p: South Africa's Consolidated Diamond Corporation (CDC) said on Monday that its financial statements for the year to June 30, 1996, are in the final stages of preparation and will be posted to shareholders on or about January 11.
The move comes after the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said on Friday CDC's listing was under threat of suspension as its failure so far to publish the results broke JSE rules.

The exchange said the company had not submitted its financial statements within six months of its year-end and gave the firm until the end of January to publish them, failing which its listing would be automatically suspended.
